subject: Supply Chain & Logistics
title: Ship from Store
description: A micro-lesson that makes Ship from Store usable.

hook.text: A customer in Dallas orders a shirt. The nearest warehouse is 500 miles away—but a local store has it.

buildup.text: Ship-from-store turns retail locations into mini fulfillment centers, shipping online orders from store inventory.

discovery.text: It puts inventory closer to customers, cutting delivery time and shipping cost simultaneously.

twist.text: Store staff aren't trained for fulfillment. Pick accuracy suffers and in-store shoppers compete for the same stock.

climax.text: Target ships 95% of online orders from stores—turning 1,900 locations into a massive fulfillment network.

punchline.text: Every store is a warehouse if you use it right.

quiz.question: What did Target achieve with ship-from-store?
options: Ships 95% of online orders from stores
